explanation.title: Read together. Review once. Keep the exact edit.

paragraphs.text: Astra read the implementation, configuration and tests together. The factory flagged a large rewrite for review; Astra approved a 92-character receipt and the factory applied the original proposed bytes. It did not generate the program a second time.
Astra added behavioral and CLI tests, ran them, and finished. The delivered program passed all five acceptance groups and all three additional graph and scale checks.

Native Astra recovered from two tool failures: Python was unavailable, and its patch tried to delete and add the same path. It then regenerated the implementation through the shell, added tests and completed in 149.4 seconds; the factory took 107.1 seconds.
The delivered program passed all five acceptance groups and all three additional graph and scale checks. Open Files to inspect the implementation and Tests for the exact results.
